name: Credentra Agents
tagline: An AI agent builder for any business
lede: A B2B SaaS where any business builds and publishes its own AI agents on a website widget, a chat page and WhatsApp.
highlights: Decoupled **channel adapters** from one conversation runtime, so all three channels run the same agent.
Hybrid Qdrant retrieval fused via **RRF** and a cross-encoder reranker raised hit@1 from **0.77 to 0.95**, for **~90%** grounded-answer accuracy at **~2s** latency.
Every model call goes through a gateway with rate limits, **NeMo guardrails** and fallbacks, plus a citation fence that fails closed: unsafe or off-policy responses cut **~30%**.
Tenant data isolated across **22 PostgreSQL tables** (17 Alembic migrations) with row-level security, composite workspace keys and RBAC (3 roles, 13 permissions).
Self-serve ingestion of text, FAQs, files and websites, with versioned revisions that go live only after an automated check: new-tenant setup cut from days to **~1 hour**.
Tenant and admin portals in Next.js and React, an embeddable Shadow-DOM chat widget, and a FastAPI backend of **63 REST endpoints** streaming replies over SSE through a JWT API proxy.
Human takeover with a live inbox and a report grouping unanswered questions: critical-issue response time cut **~40%**, time to find content gaps cut **~50%**.

name: OCR & KYC pipeline
tagline: Identity documents for APB Bank, Laos
lede: A GPU-accelerated OCR pipeline that reads passports, national IDs and family cards for a bank in Laos.
highlights: **~95%** field-extraction accuracy on **500+** KYC documents a day.
Automated image correction and GPU-accelerated field extraction on NVIDIA L4 GPUs.
Fault-tolerant multi-node inference with automatic **GPU-to-CPU failover** behind FastAPI microservices and Nginx: **~99%** uptime in production.
APIs secured with OAuth2 and JWT.

name: OCR invoice automation
tagline: Thai and English invoices for Taco Bell Thailand
lede: Mixed Thai and English invoice processing, run on the client’s own infrastructure to keep financial data private.
highlights: **~95%** per-document accuracy across **5 invoice templates**, combining open-source OCR (Typhoon OCR) with rule-based field mapping.
A monitoring dashboard with review and Excel export for the finance team.
Deployed on-premises, so financial data never leaves the client.

name: TourExc
tagline: A travel and tourism booking platform
lede: Customer, agent and admin workflows for tour packages, bookings, leads and cross-country pricing.
highlights: Built the **customer, agent and admin** workflows across tour packages, bookings, leads and cross-country pricing.
A **B2B agent portal** where partners manage their clients’ bookings.
Admin tooling for multimedia listings and taxi bookings.

name: CBSE learning platform
lede: An AI-powered learning platform for CBSE students, shipped end to end as a 2-month MVP.
highlights: Curriculum-grounded AI subject tutors via **RAG**, personalised per class and subject.
A learning-assessment engine tracking **25 CBSE-aligned parameters** (Bloom’s Taxonomy, metacognition), with rule-based and LLM-assisted scoring.
An OCR and LLM grading workflow for answer sheets cut estimated manual grading effort by **~50%**.
Owned the backend, AI services, frontend and deployment of the **2-month MVP** on Render, iterated on live demo-user feedback.
